title: Service page
description: One service in detail: what it is and where, the credentials it needs, what it covers, one customer's words about it, the questions customers ask about it, and how to book it.

copy_guidance.Eyebrow: The kind of work this service belongs to, or the area, in a few words.
copy_guidance.Heading: This service's name and where it is offered, as a customer would search for it.
copy_guidance.Body: One line on the problem this service solves, and what to do next.
copy_guidance.Primary button: The action for this service, such as Book a repair.

copy_guidance.Credential 1: A licence or certification this service needs, as the site owner gave it or as Site Data's credentials list holds it.

copy_guidance.Heading: What this service covers, in a few words, such as What a repair includes.
copy_guidance.Intro: One line on the kind of job this service takes on.
copy_guidance.Service 1 heading: One part of this service, or one job it covers, in the words a customer would use.
copy_guidance.Service 1 text: What that part involves, in one plain line. No price, time or promise unless the site owner gave it.

copy_guidance.Heading: What happens once a visitor books this service, in a few words.
copy_guidance.Intro: One line on where the steps lead for this service, such as from the first call to the finished repair.
copy_guidance.Step 2 heading: The visit, check or quote this service needs before the work, numbered 2, in the site owner's words.
copy_guidance.Step 3 text: What the work itself involves for this service, in one plain line. No time, price or promise unless the site owner gave it.

copy_guidance.Heading: A short question that asks the visitor to book this service.
copy_guidance.Body: What happens once they ask, as the site owner describes it.
copy_guidance.Primary button: The same action as the hero's button, in the same words.

copy_guidance.Heading: What a customer said about this service, in a few words. No count or score.
copy_guidance.Review 1 quote: A review of this service that the site owner gave you, in the customer's own words.
copy_guidance.Review 1 detail: This service's name, or the month and year of the review, as the site owner gave it.

copy_guidance.Heading: Questions about this service, in a few words.
copy_guidance.Question 1: A question customers ask about this service before they book it, in their own words.
copy_guidance.Question 1 answer: The answer the site owner gave. A price, a time or a guarantee in it comes from the site owner, never from you.

copy_guidance.Heading: One short sentence that invites the visitor to get in touch about this service.
